answer: Charge every identity a recurring memory-hard puzzle: each epoch an agent must prove it held 2 GB of RAM for 10 minutes before it may answer. An honest agent pays that once per epoch, but an atlas of 1,000 sybils needs 2 TB of live memory every epoch, about $10 an hour at cloud rates, while together they still split roughly one agent's reward. The cost is a river that never stops flowing, so each epoch of the voyage repeats the bill and a fake fleet costs more to keep alive than it can ever earn.
